definitions.explanation: The act of entering a restricted or prohibited area. Most commonly seen in prohibition signs and warnings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{立|た}ち{入|い}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from entering, as construction is underway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧{立|た}ち{入|い}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{罰|ばっ}せられる→罰する：02401_bassuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Unauthorized entry may be punishable by law.

notes:
{立|た}ち{入|い}り means entering an area, especially one that is restricted. Most commonly encountered as part of prohibition signs.

FORMS:
The verb is ⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}る→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧ (to enter, to trespass). This noun form is the masu-stem nominalization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{入|い}り{禁止|きんし}: no entry, keep out (the most common phrase)
- {立|た}ち{入|い}り⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: on-site inspection (by authorities)
- {立|た}ち{入|い}り⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: on-site investigation
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧{立|た}ち{入|い}り: unauthorized entry
- {立|た}ち{入|い}り⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: entry restrictions

USAGE:
Almost always used in formal, official, or legal contexts. You will see {立|た}ち{入|い}り{禁止|きんし} on signs at construction sites, private property, and restricted areas. In everyday conversation, ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ is the normal word for entering.
